description: Defines a template class 'PingPongEnabled' providing WebSocket ping-pong functionality, including methods for starting ping, handling pong responses, timeouts, and connection state logging.

classes.name: PingPongEnabled
classes.description: A template class providing WebSocket ping-pong heartbeat functionality, designed to be inherited by other classes.

methods.name: startPing
methods.description: Initializes ping process by setting pong handlers and scheduling periodic pings.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Sets a timer to invoke a callback after a specified interval.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message if the connection is open.

methods.name: onPong
methods.description: Handles receipt of a pong message and reschedules the next ping.

methods.name: onPongTimeout
methods.description: Handles pong timeout by closing the connection.
